P.name: Fey Feathers
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Rakan''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|30 + (225-30)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 95% AP)}} that lasts until broken. After being [[out of combat]] for 5 seconds, any leftover shield will be restored to '''maximum''' value.
P.description2: '''Rakan's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} <!--{{tip|on-attack}}?--> and {{tip|ability}} hits reduce ''Fey Feathers' '' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Lover's Leap:}} If either '''Rakan''' or {{ci|Xayah}} is channeling {{si|Recall}}, the other may move nearby and channel their own to join alongside them. '''Both''' reach base at the time of which the initiator's {{si|Recall}} completes.
P.cooldown: {{pp|40 to 14.5 for 18; then -0.875*x for 2|formula=40 - 1.5 * level until level 18, then -0.875 per level}}

Q.name: Gleaming Quill
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rakan''' slings an enchanted feather in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.
Q.description2: If the target was an enemy {{tip|champion}} or epic {{tip|monster}}, a radius is marked around '''Rakan'''. After 3 seconds or if an allied champion enters the radius, '''Rakan''' {{tip|heals}} himself and nearby allied champions for {{pp|40 + (210-40)*(x-1)/17|1 to 20 by 1|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}.

W.name: Grand Entrance
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rakan''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location. After a {{fd|0.35}}-second delay upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for 1 second.
W.description2: '''''Rakan''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.''

E.name: Battle Dance
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rakan''' grants a {{tip|shield}} to the target allied champion for 3 seconds and then {{tip|dash|dashes}} to and around them. ''Battle Dance'' can be recast within 5 seconds at no additional cost.
E.description3: '''''Rakan''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.''
E.description4: ''If {{ci|Xayah}} is the target, Battle Dance can be cast from an increased range.''

R.name: The Quickness
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rakan''' breaks into a captivating sprint for 4 seconds, gaining {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|75% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for the duration. During this time, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he collides with and {{tip|charm|charms}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 75% for a duration. This cannot affect the same enemy more than once.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 300}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Disable Duration|{{ap|1 to 1.5}} seconds}}
R.description2: Colliding with an enemy {{tip|champion}} extends ''The Quickness' ''duration by {{fd|0.25}} seconds, which can occur once per champion. When '''Rakan''' collides with his first enemy champion, he gains an additional {{as|75% '''bonus''' movement speed}} that decays after {{fd|0.5}} seconds by 20% every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, then by 15% after decaying by 60% over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
R.description4: ''During The Quickness, '''Rakan''' cannot basic attack enemy champions he did not collide with, unless the attack command was inputted before the ability was activated.''
